spans.s:
Nāya in two passages of the Rigveda^1 is, according to the
St. Petersburg Dictionary, probably a proper name. Sāyaṇa
takes the word to mean ‘leader,’ while Pischel^2 considers it
a gerund with passive sense.
1) vi. 24, 10; 46, 11.
2) Vedische Studien, 1, 41. For other
explanations, see Oldenberg, Ṛgveda-
Noten, 1, 123, 370.
